passages.text: Now when Hiram king of Tyre heard that Solomon had been anointed king in his father’s place, he sent envoys to Solomon; for Hiram had always been a friend of David.
passages.sermon:
Hiram was the king of Tyre.
Hiram heard that Solomon had become king after his father David.
Hiram knew that Solomon was anointed as king.
Hiram had always been a friend to David.
Hiram sent his servants to Solomon.
passages.original: וַ֠יִּשְׁלַח חִירָ֨ם מֶֽלֶךְ־ צ֤וֹר אֶת־ עֲבָדָיו֙ אֶל־ שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה כִּ֣י שָׁמַ֔ע כִּ֥י אֹת֛וֹ מָשְׁח֥וּ לְמֶ֖לֶךְ תַּ֣חַת אָבִ֑יהוּ כִּ֣י אֹהֵ֗ב הָיָ֥ה חִירָ֛ם לְדָוִ֖ד כָּל־ הַיָּמִֽים׃ס

passages.text: And Solomon relayed this message to Hiram: “As you are well aware, due to the wars waged on all sides against my father David, he could not build a house for the Name of the LORD his God until the LORD had put his enemies under his feet.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was the king of Israel.
Solomon sent a message to Hiram, king of Tyre.
Solomon said to Hiram, “You know about my father David.
David was my father.
David could not build a house for the Name of the LORD his God.
David could not build this house because there were wars around him.
Enemies surrounded David on every side.
David had to wait until the LORD put his enemies under his feet.
Only after that could the house be built for the LORD.”
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה אֶל־ חִירָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃ אַתָּ֨ה יָדַ֜עְתָּ אֶת־ דָּוִ֣ד אָבִ֗י כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָכֹל֙ לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֗יִת לְשֵׁם֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֔יו מִפְּנֵ֥י הַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר סְבָבֻ֑הוּ עַ֤ד תֵּת־ יְהוָה֙ אֹתָ֔ם תַּ֖חַת כַּפּ֥וֹת רַגְלוֹ׃

passages.text: But now the LORD my God has given me rest on every side, and there is no adversary or crisis.
passages.sermon:
Solomon is king of Israel.
The LORD is Solomon’s God.
The LORD has given Solomon rest.
Solomon has rest on every side.
There is no adversary against Solomon.
There is no crisis for Solomon.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה הֵנִ֨יחַ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהַ֛י לִ֖י מִסָּבִ֑יב אֵ֣ין שָׂטָ֔ן וְאֵ֖ין פֶּ֥גַע רָֽע׃

passages.text: So behold, I plan to build a house for the Name of the LORD my God, according to what the LORD said to my father David: ‘I will put your son on your throne in your place, and he will build the house for My Name.’
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.  
Solomon spoke to Hiram, king of Tyre.  
Solomon said he would build a house.  
This house would honor the Name of the LORD, Solomon’s God.  
The LORD had spoken to David, Solomon’s father.  
The LORD said to David, “I will place your son on your throne after you.”  
The LORD said, “Your son will build the house for My Name.”  
Solomon planned to fulfill this promise.  
Solomon would build the house for the LORD.
passages.original: וְהִנְנִ֣י אֹמֵ֔ר לִבְנ֣וֹת בַּ֔יִת לְשֵׁ֖ם יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהָ֑י כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ דִּבֶּ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־ דָּוִ֤ד אָבִי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר בִּנְךָ֗ אֲשֶׁ֨ר אֶתֵּ֤ן תַּחְתֶּ֙יךָ֙ עַל־ כִּסְאֶ֔ךָ הֽוּא־ יִבְנֶ֥ה הַבַּ֖יִת לִשְׁמִֽי׃

passages.text: Now therefore, order that cedars of Lebanon be cut down for me. My servants will be with your servants, and I will pay your servants whatever wages you set, for you know that there are none among us as skilled in logging as the Sidonians.”
passages.sermon:
King Solomon spoke to Hiram, king of Tyre.
Solomon wanted to build a house for the LORD God.
Solomon needed cedar wood from Lebanon.
Solomon said, "Order that cedars from Lebanon be cut down for me."
"My servants will work together with your servants."
"I will pay your servants whatever wages you decide."
"You know that no one among us is as skilled at cutting wood as the Sidonians."
The Sidonians are famous for their skill in logging.
Solomon asked for help because of their great skill.
passages.original: וְעַתָּ֡ה צַוֵּה֩ וְיִכְרְתוּ־ לִ֨י אֲרָזִ֜ים מִן־ הַלְּבָנ֗וֹן וַֽעֲבָדַי֙ יִהְי֣וּ עִם־ עֲבָדֶ֔יךָ וּשְׂכַ֤ר עֲבָדֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶתֵּ֣ן לְךָ֔ כְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר תֹּאמֵ֑ר כִּ֣י׀ אַתָּ֣ה יָדַ֗עְתָּ כִּ֣י אֵ֥ין בָּ֛נוּ אִ֛ישׁ יֹדֵ֥עַ לִכְרָת־ עֵצִ֖ים כַּצִּדֹנִֽים׃

passages.text: When Hiram received Solomon’s message, he rejoiced greatly and said, “Blessed be the LORD this day! He has given David a wise son over this great people!”
passages.sermon:
Hiram was the king of Tyre.
Solomon was the king of Israel.
Solomon sent a message to Hiram.
Hiram heard Solomon’s words.
Hiram became very happy.
Hiram said, “Blessed be the LORD today!”
Hiram said, “The LORD has given David a wise son.”
Hiram said, “This wise son rules over this great people.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֞י כִּשְׁמֹ֧עַ חִירָ֛ם אֶת־ דִּבְרֵ֥י שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה וַיִּשְׂמַ֣ח מְאֹ֑ד וַיֹּ֗אמֶר בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ הַיּ֔וֹם אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתַ֤ן לְדָוִד֙ בֵּ֣ן חָכָ֔ם עַל־ הָעָ֥ם הָרָ֖ב הַזֶּֽה׃

passages.text: Then Hiram sent a reply to Solomon, saying: “I have received your message; I will do all you desire regarding the cedar and cypress timber.
passages.sermon:
Hiram was the king of Tyre.
Hiram sent a message to Solomon.
Hiram said, "I have heard your request."
Hiram said, "I will do everything you want."
Hiram said, "I will provide cedar wood."
Hiram said, "I will provide cypress wood."
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח חִירָם֙ אֶל־ שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה לֵאמֹ֔ר שָׁמַ֕עְתִּי אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁלַ֖חְתָּ אֵלָ֑י אֲנִ֤י אֶֽעֱשֶׂה֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ חֶפְצְךָ֔ בַּעֲצֵ֥י אֲרָזִ֖ים וּבַעֲצֵ֥י בְרוֹשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: My servants will haul the logs from Lebanon to the Sea, and I will float them as rafts by sea to the place you specify. There I will separate the logs, and you can take them away. And in exchange, you can meet my needs by providing my household with food.”
passages.sermon:
Hiram was the king of Tyre.
Hiram spoke to Solomon.
Hiram said his servants would cut the logs.
His servants would bring the logs down from Lebanon to the sea.
Hiram would tie the logs together as rafts.
He would float the rafts by sea.
He would send the rafts to the place Solomon chose.
At that place, Hiram would separate the logs.
Solomon could take the logs from there.
Hiram asked Solomon to provide food for his household in return.
passages.original: עֲ֠בָדַי יֹרִ֨דוּ מִן־ הַלְּבָנ֜וֹן יָ֗מָּה וַ֠אֲנִי אֲשִׂימֵ֨ם דֹּבְר֤וֹת בַּיָּם֙ עַֽד־ הַמָּק֞וֹם אֲשֶׁר־ תִּשְׁלַ֥ח אֵלַ֛י וְנִפַּצְתִּ֥ים שָׁ֖ם וְאַתָּ֣ה תִשָּׂ֑א וְאַתָּה֙ תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה אֶת־ חֶפְצִ֔י לָתֵ֖ת לֶ֥חֶם בֵּיתִֽי׃

passages.text: So Hiram provided Solomon with all the cedar and cypress timber he wanted, and year after year Solomon would provide Hiram with 20,000 cors of wheat as food for his household, as well as 20,000 baths of pure olive oil.
passages.sermon:
Hiram was the king of Tyre.
Solomon was the king of Israel.
Hiram gave Solomon all the cedar wood he wanted.
Hiram gave Solomon all the cypress wood he wanted.
Solomon gave Hiram 20,000 cors of wheat each year.
Solomon gave this wheat for Hiram’s household.
Solomon also gave Hiram 20,000 baths of pure olive oil each year.
Solomon did this for Hiram every year.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֨י חִיר֜וֹם נֹתֵ֣ן לִשְׁלֹמֹ֗ה עֲצֵ֧י אֲרָזִ֛ים וַעֲצֵ֥י בְרוֹשִׁ֖ים כָּל־ חֶפְצֽוֹ׃ וּשְׁלֹמֹה֩ נָתַ֨ן לְחִירָ֜ם עֶשְׂרִים֩ אֶ֨לֶף כֹּ֤ר חִטִּים֙ מַכֹּ֣לֶת לְבֵית֔וֹ וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים כֹּ֖ר שֶׁ֣מֶן כָּתִ֑ית כֹּֽה־ יִתֵּ֧ן שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה לְחִירָ֖ם שָׁנָ֥ה בְשָׁנָֽה׃פ

passages.text: And the LORD gave Solomon wisdom, as He had promised him. There was peace between Hiram and Solomon, and the two of them made a treaty.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gave Solomon wisdom.
The LORD had promised to give Solomon wisdom.
There was peace between Hiram and Solomon.
Hiram was king of Tyre.
Solomon was king of Israel.
Hiram and Solomon made a treaty together.
passages.original: וַיהוָ֗ה נָתַ֤ן חָכְמָה֙ לִשְׁלֹמֹ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר־ ל֑וֹ וַיְהִ֣י שָׁלֹ֗ם בֵּ֤ין חִירָם֙ וּבֵ֣ין שְׁלֹמֹ֔ה וַיִּכְרְת֥וּ בְרִ֖ית שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Then King Solomon conscripted a labor force of 30,000 men from all Israel.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon ruled over Israel.
King Solomon needed workers for his projects.
King Solomon chose men from all Israel.
King Solomon conscripted a labor force.
The labor force had 30,000 men.
passages.original: וַיַּ֨עַל הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה מַ֖ס מִכָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְהִ֣י הַמַּ֔ס שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ׃

passages.text: He sent them to Lebanon in monthly shifts of 10,000 men, so that they would spend one month in Lebanon and two months at home. And Adoniram was in charge of the forced labor.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon ruled Israel.
He conscripted workers from all Israel.
He sent 10,000 men to Lebanon each month.
These men worked in shifts.
Each group spent one month in Lebanon.
Each group spent two months at home.
Adoniram supervised the forced labor.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלָחֵ֣ם לְבָנ֗וֹנָה עֲשֶׂ֨רֶת אֲלָפִ֤ים בַּחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ חֲלִיפ֔וֹת חֹ֚דֶשׁ יִהְי֣וּ בַלְּבָנ֔וֹן שְׁנַ֥יִם חֳדָשִׁ֖ים בְּבֵית֑וֹ וַאֲדֹנִירָ֖ם עַל־ הַמַּֽס׃ס

passages.text: Solomon had 70,000 porters and 80,000 stonecutters in the mountains, not including his 3,300 foremen who supervised the workers.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon ruled over Israel.
He had many workers for his building projects.
He had 70,000 porters.
These porters carried loads.
He had 80,000 stonecutters.
These stonecutters worked in the mountains.
He also had 3,300 foremen.
These foremen supervised the workers.
The foremen watched over the people doing the work.
The number of porters and stonecutters does not include the foremen.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֧י לִשְׁלֹמֹ֛ה שִׁבְעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף נֹשֵׂ֣א סַבָּ֑ל וּשְׁמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף חֹצֵ֥ב בָּהָֽר׃ לְ֠בַד מִשָּׂרֵ֨י הַנִּצָּבִ֤ים לִשְׁלֹמֹה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הַמְּלָאכָ֔ה שְׁלֹ֥שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֖ים וּשְׁלֹ֣שׁ מֵא֑וֹת הָרֹדִ֣ים בָּעָ֔ם הָעֹשִׂ֖ים בַּמְּלָאכָֽה׃

passages.text: And the king commanded them to quarry large, costly stones to lay the foundation of the temple with dressed stones.
passages.sermon:
King Solomon gave a command.
He told the workers to quarry stones.
The stones were large.
The stones were valuable.
The workers used these stones for the foundation of the temple.
The stones were cut and shaped.
passages.original: וַיְצַ֣ו הַמֶּ֡לֶךְ וַיַּסִּעוּ֩ אֲבָנִ֨ים גְּדֹל֜וֹת אֲבָנִ֧ים יְקָר֛וֹת לְיַסֵּ֥ד הַבָּ֖יִת אַבְנֵ֥י גָזִֽית׃

passages.text: So Solomon’s and Hiram’s builders, along with the Gebalites, quarried the stone and prepared the timber and stone for the construction of the temple.
passages.sermon:
Solomon was king of Israel.
Hiram was king of Tyre.
The Gebalites were skilled workers from Gebal.
Solomon’s builders worked on the temple.
Hiram’s builders also worked on the temple.
The Gebalites joined them in the work.
They cut and shaped the stones.
They prepared the timber.
They prepared the stones.
They made everything ready to build the temple.
passages.original: וַֽיִּפְסְל֞וּ בֹּנֵ֧י שְׁלֹמֹ֛ה וּבֹנֵ֥י חִיר֖וֹם וְהַגִּבְלִ֑ים וַיָּכִ֛ינוּ הָעֵצִ֥ים וְהָאֲבָנִ֖ים לִבְנ֥וֹת הַבָּֽיִת׃פ
